newsitem.title: UK: UK MEALS AND FEEDS LOWER ON QUIET MARKET.
newsitem.headline: UK MEALS AND FEEDS LOWER ON QUIET MARKET.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices drifted lower on Wednesday but business remained quiet.
Brokers reported only small tonnage's changing hands with most business on a hand-to-mouth basis.
"There still is not enough confidence in the market for people to buy forwards in again great amounts" said one broker.
Offers for high protein soy meal were around one stg down from the mill and stores while the remainder of the market was little changed.
